title: Create A Custom Fragrance at Chicago’s Original Perfumery
includes: A bottle of fragrance to take home and love
Tip, if you so choose to leave it :) (cash only) (not included)
Additional products (lotions, shower gels, bath salts, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You’ll be creating a unique fragrance that is true to you! We save it on file so you can order refills (at a discounted rate as long as you keep your bottle) and we rotate fragrances on the bar so you can always come in to create a new scent too!

We’ve been around for over 30 years (established 1993) and have been a hidden gem in Chicago’s beautiful Lincoln Park area for the entire time. Nothing beats experience and trained perfumers to help guide and create the right proportions for you!

We are BYOB—just board liquor allowed. But beer, wine, or a few hard seltzers are ok. 

It’s the perfect outing for date night, bachelorette parties, bridal showers, birthdays, business outings or even solo!

For bigger groups (5+) you will have to book on our website or give us a call for instructions. 

It is a private activity in the sense that you get your own table or seating with your reservation—just like you would at a restaurant.
